desc:
Fossil Creek, 1986. The emergency broadcast came in at sundown: stay indoors, lights off, do not go outside. Nobody said why. Then the crickets stopped.

You and your friends are holed up in a house on the edge of the woods with no way out until morning. Lock every door. Board every window. Keep the generator running. Whatever is out there is learning the house as fast as you are.

They hunt by sound. They hunt by light. They hunt in packs. Hide when they get in, stay quiet, and make it to sunrise.

🦖 CHAPTER 2 here now!

⚙️ Lobby Options:
• Choose your night
• Difficulty
• Friends Only

🎮 Controls:
• Sprint - Shift
• Sneak - C
• Flashlight - F
• Flare - R
• Weapons - G / H (Click to use)
• Power-ups - 1 to 5
• Interact / Hide - E
• Lock Doors / Board Windows - Q

⭐ Roblox Plus Benefits:
• 1 free revive every night

📱💻🎮 All Devices Supported

👍 Like and favorite the game for updates
🎧 Headphones strongly recommended
🖼️ Max graphics recommended
